title: Traveller Club Relief Against a Withheld Share on Car Hire
content:
A renter's Wanderlane Traveller Club membership may reduce the share withheld when a Car Rental Rate Classes
rental is given up. What decides it is the tier the renter's membership stands at, the car rental discount
that tier carries, and how much money stands settled in advance on the rental.

| Standing of the renter's Wanderlane Traveller Club membership | Money settled in advance on the rental | Relief against the share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active, and the tier carries a car rental discount of 5 per cent or more | 300 USD or more | that tier's own car rental discount |
| active, and the tier carries any car rental discount | more than nothing | 2 per cent |

Where the renter holds an active club membership whose tier carries a car rental discount of at least
5 per cent and the money settled in advance on the rental reaches 300 USD, the share is reduced by that
tier's car rental discount. Where the renter holds an active club membership whose tier carries any car
rental discount and money has been settled in advance on the rental, the share is reduced by 2 per cent.
Where neither holds of a rental, no relief under this head is given against its share.

## Conditions of the relief

The two marks of the first row must hold together. A membership whose tier carries a car rental discount of
4 per cent meets neither the 5 per cent threshold nor anything above it, and a rental carrying 250 USD of
money settled in advance does not reach the 300 USD figure; in either case the first row is not reached.

A membership that is not active carries no relief at all under this head, whatever tier it names and however
much stands settled in advance.

The relief is a reduction of the share, expressed as a percentage of it, and not a sum of money taken off
the rental.
